scope: LQ-F spike for the exact later-quantum profile (Server identity seed and Server ephemeral scalars revealed post-run, beyond LQ) and its two review fix passes: a logged source (source14 with a logged accept and a Server read) with its projection back to source14, and over SourceSpec + LaterRead the selected-first reservation, the monitor, the KEM cut carrying the selected accept ephemeral as an explicit value, T4, the KEM hop (generalized over the scanned program), T6, the composed KEM transfer and the bills of the KEM adversary. The first fix pass logs the ephemeral whenever generation was reached (design table), adds the transcript conjunct of later_read, renames the exposed flattened handler of LaterServerBills, and corrects docstrings; the second fix pass rewords the remaining Server-read docstrings, renames the Server-read cap binder of LaterServerBills and states the profile per plan section 27. Profile (owner decision, plan section 27): every honest X25519 secret and every honest Ed25519 identity secret, except two kinds of scalar that are never published or used: (a) the one-time scalars of failed Beacon bundle attempts (generated at beaconcrypt/src/beacon.rs:302, dropped when signing or serializing the bundle fails at beacon.rs:349-357, public key never output) and (b) the Server ephemeral of an accept that fails the PQ-key parse (generated at beaconcrypt/src/server.rs:368, dropped when the parse rejects at server.rs:369-372, before encapsulation, any DH step or any publication). Both are documented with this reason and get no further proof work; with LQ-F they replace deviation D6 of LQ. The LQ-F reveal leaves out (a) (in no state) and also contains (b), because the log records every generated ephemeral; no statement relies on that. DH outputs are derived, not listed; ML-KEM secrets are never revealed. The spike and the first fix pass were reviewed (semantic and hygiene, approve with nits); the second fix pass is not reviewed; not merged.

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLaterServerCut.ordered_cu:
theorem ordered_cut (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (identityIndex : Nat) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) (consumed : List Pqxdh.Bytes) :
    PqxdhRegistrationJointKemCut.scan setup ((ordered setup codec checks identityIndex raw).run consumed) 0 =
      match PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks raw with
      | none => pure (.complete ((none, none), consumed))
      | some value => simulateQ (actual setup)
          ((simulateQ (PqxdhRegistrationJointKemSourceSuffix.handler setup codec checks identityIndex raw)
            (PqxdhDeploymentLaterServerSource.beforeLogged value)).run consumed) >>= fun prepared =>
          match prepared.1.1 with
          | none => pure (.complete ((none, prepared.1.2), prepared.2))
          | some ephemeral => pure (.pending (raw, value.keys.pqKey) fun reply =>
              (fun input => ((input.1, some ephemeral.secret), input.2)) <$>
                (PqxdhRegistrationJointKemSourceSuffix.suffix setup codec checks identityIndex raw value
                  ephemeral reply).run prepared.2)

theorem selected_source (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (identityIndex : Nat) (publicIdentity : PublicIdentity) (work : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) Result) (count : Nat)
    (bounded : work.IsQueryBoundP (fun query => laterKind (KemSK := KemSK) query = some (.inl 1)) (count + 1))
    (owners : List EncodedEntry) (log : Log) (state : NativeState KemSK)
    (joint : PqxdhDynamicIdentityPool.SourceState) (selected : Fin (count + 1)) :
    𝒮[(fun result => (some result.1, result.2)) <$>
      (simulateQ (PqxdhLiveKemBirth.impl setup.baseImpl setup.joint setup.kem)
        (simulateQ (actual setup) (commands setup codec checks identityIndex publicIdentity work owners log state))).run
          (joint, PqxdhLiveKemBirth.empty)] =
      𝒮[do
        let chosen ← simulateQ (PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.kemAmbientImpl setup.baseImpl) setup.kem.keygen
        let others ← PqxdhLiveKemSelection.sampleFamily
          (simulateQ (PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.kemAmbientImpl setup.baseImpl) setup.kem.keygen) count
        let pairs := List.ofFn (selected.insertNth chosen others)
        Prod.map id (PqxdhDynamicKemJointSource.project pairs) <$>
          (((simulateQ (PqxdhDynamicKemJointSource.normal setup.baseImpl setup.joint setup.kem selected.val pairs)
            (simulateQ (actual setup) (commands setup codec checks identityIndex publicIdentity work owners log
              state))).run).run (joint, PqxdhDynamicKemRouter.empty))]
